NEET UG Counselling Results and Dates Announced for Multiple States

Results for AP NEET UG 2026 Phase 2 allotment have been released, with 1,205 MBBS seats allotted. Separately, the UP NEET UG Counselling 2026 Round 2 merit list has been released. A revised counselling schedule for AP PGECET 2026 has also been announced, with the seat allotment result for 2026 to be released on October 4.
